parakeet: These are not abstract philosophical musings. They are concrete claims about the nature of reality, many of which are easily debunked or exposed as myth once we apply history, anthropology, or basic critical thinking. Once those claims fall, the God falls with them because the claim doesn't stand on its own. It's not just there is a God, it's there is this God who did these things and therefore deserves this kind of obedience, faith, or worship. And once the actions and attributes don't hold up, the figures lose all legitimacy.
